MostTracked.title: Most Tracked

empty.trending: Nothing new is trending right now.

MostTracked.unavailable: Most Tracked is unavailable right now. It will be back in a few minutes.
MostTracked.privacyNote: Counts are selections in KeepTrack over the last day, at most 3 per person per object. Approximate and anonymous.

help.overview: Most Tracked shows the objects KeepTrack users are looking at most right now, like the most-tracked lists on flight trackers. It is a quick way to find launches, reentries and other objects in the news.
help.tabs: Top 25 ranks the most-tracked objects over the last day. New & Trending shows the most popular objects that were not in the previous day's Top 25, so new and interesting objects are not hidden behind the usual favorites.
help.howToUse:
1. Open Most Tracked from the drawer.
  2. Switch between Top 25 and New & Trending.
  3. Click a row to select that object and fly to it.
  4. Click Refresh for the latest counts.
help.tip1: The bar shows each object's popularity relative to the first row of the same list.
help.tip2: Greyed-out rows are objects that are not in the catalog you have loaded, so they cannot be selected.
